localization.title: Localization
localization.lead: Wording is runtime content, not build output. A release is published to storage and picked up by the running app.
localization.manifestBody: The app reads one manifest per environment. It names the active release, the locales and the fallback chain.
localization.releaseBody: Bundle paths contain the release id, so a bundle is cached forever and a rollback is a manifest edit.
localization.editBody: Text is edited and approved in the translation management system, exported by pipeline, and served from the CDN.
localization.formattingBody: Numbers, dates and currency use Intl with the active locale. Plurals and gender use ICU MessageFormat.
